title: WellSpan's AI agent Ana handles 160,000 patient calls a month as partnership expands
summary: WellSpan Health said its Hippocratic AI agent Ana currently manages more than 160,000 patient calls per month and more than 7,000 hours of conversation, answering inbound calls and scheduling primary care appointments. Under the expanded partnership Ana will take on post-discharge follow-up and chronic disease check-ins, starting with outreach to patients who missed imaging appointments, and WellSpan said every new use will follow a governance, safety and implementation structure developed with its medical and clinical teams.
